h1: The 6 Best Glass Electric Kettles of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Glass Electric Kettles 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six glass electric kettles from 1.2L to 1.8L, including temperature-control and gooseneck models, with specs compared.
summary: The Amazon Basics 1.7L glass kettle is the best value for most kitchens. The Chefman 1.8L with temperature control and gooseneck suits tea and pour-over, the Cuisinart 1.7L is the variable-temperature pick, and the Chefman 1.2L with infuser fits small households.
intro: Glass kettles look great and show you the water boil, but the mistake is buying for looks alone. The base, lid and spout parts are plastic or metal, and what matters is how the kettle pours and how much it holds.
We reviewed glass kettles on listed capacity, wattage, temperature control and spout design. Six made the list, ranked by how much each offers for its price bracket.

products.name: Amazon Basics Electric Kettle with Glass Carafe for Tea and Coffee
products.verdict: A 1.7 liter, 1500W glass kettle at under $25.
products.description:
This Amazon Basics kettle is a glass carafe model rated 1500W with 1.7 liters of capacity, listed under $25.

It wins on price per liter, though it has no temperature control. Against the Chefman 1.8L, it holds slightly less.

It suits households that just boil water. Check the lid and base materials on the listing.

products.name: Chefman Electric Kettle with Temperature Control
products.verdict: A 1.8 liter glass kettle with temperature control and a gooseneck spout.
products.description:
The Chefman has 1.8 liters of glass capacity, temperature control and a gooseneck spout. It costs $25-50.

It ranks second because the gooseneck and temperature settings add real function over the Amazon Basics. Against the Cuisinart, it costs less.

It suits tea and pour-over fans.

products.name: Cuisinart 1.7L Glass Variable Temperature Control Electric Kettle
products.verdict: A 1.7 liter glass kettle with variable temperature control.
products.description:
The Cuisinart is a 1.7 liter glass kettle with variable temperature control, in the $50-100 bracket.

It ranks third because it costs more than the Chefman with similar function. Against the Amazon Basics, it adds variable temperature.

It suits tea and coffee drinkers who value the brand.

products.name: Chefman Electric Kettle
products.verdict: The largest glass kettle here at under $25.
products.description:
This Chefman is a 1.8 liter, 1500W glass kettle priced under $25.

It ranks fourth because it has no temperature control. Against the Amazon Basics 1.7L, it holds a bit more.

It suits frequent boilers.

products.name: GreenLife 1.7 Liter Electric Glass Kettle
products.verdict: A plain 1.7 liter glass kettle in the $25-50 bracket.
products.description:
The GreenLife is a 1.7 liter glass kettle priced $25-50 with few listed extras.

It ranks fifth because the Amazon Basics matches the capacity for less. Against the Chefman, it lacks temperature control.

It suits buyers who like the GreenLife line.

products.name: CHEFMAN Electric Kettle - 1.2L 1500W Hot Water Tea Pot with Infuser
products.verdict: A 1.2 liter, 1500W kettle with infuser and gooseneck spout.
products.description:
This Chefman holds 1.2 liters, runs at 1500W and has a gooseneck spout and an infuser. It is listed under $25.

It ranks last because of the small capacity. Against the larger Chefman, it suits one or two people.

It works for desks and small kitchens.

whatMatters.detail: Capacity sets how many cups you boil in one go. 1.7L suits most households. Check liters in the title.
Green and white teas want cooler water than coffee. Variable control lets you pick. Check for it in the title.
Gooseneck spouts give slow, precise pours. Standard spouts pour faster. Check the spout name.
Higher wattage boils faster. 1500W is common. Check the number.
Glass shows water level but gets hot. Lids and bases use other materials. Check the listing.
